# CloudTopia — Digital & Cloud Technologies

> CloudTopia is a Gulf-first digital agency. We build websites, e-commerce stores, custom business systems, QR menus, and web applications — bilingual Arabic + English, with native Mada/Apple Pay/STC Pay/Tabby/Tamara payment integrations and ZATCA Phase 2 e-invoicing for Saudi Arabia.

## What we do

- **Website Design & Development** — Custom-built, conversion-focused websites with advanced SEO and bilingual support (Arabic + English). One-time pricing from $299 (landing) / $499 (5-page) / $999 (15-page) / $2,499 (premium).
- **E-Commerce Stores** — Full Gulf-ready stores with Mada, Apple Pay, STC Pay, Tabby, Tamara, ZATCA Phase 2 e-invoicing, and bilingual checkout. From $599 (starter) / $1,299 (growth) / custom (enterprise).
- **Business Systems & Custom Software** — Custom CRM, inventory, POS, HR, booking, and ERP-style systems built around Gulf workflows. From $1,999 (essential) / $3,499 (advanced) / custom (enterprise).
- **Web Applications** — Custom web apps, portals, dashboards, SaaS platforms on Next.js + React + PostgreSQL. From $999 (foundation) / $2,499 (professional) / custom (enterprise ERP).
- **Mobile App Development** — iOS, Android, Flutter, React Native, MVP, customer, staff, booking, delivery/order, app backend/API, App Store launch, and maintenance services. From $2,999 (starter) / $7,999 (cross-platform) / custom (app ecosystem).
- **QR Menu Systems** — Bilingual QR menus for cafés and restaurants with order-and-pay, Mada/Apple Pay, ZATCA receipts, kitchen printer integration. From $249 (essential) / $499 (smart) / $649 (full multi-branch).
- **Social Media Marketing** — Strategy, content, ads, and community for Gulf brands. From $199/mo (starter) / $449/mo (growth) / $799/mo (scale).
- **Content Creation** — SEO-optimized blogs, articles, and copy in Arabic + English. From $149/mo (basic) / $329/mo (professional) / $549/mo (agency).

## Key facts

- **Founded**: 2024
- **Currency support**: USD, SAR, AED, KWD
- **Languages**: English, Arabic (with full RTL) — every site bilingual by default
- **Markets served**: Saudi Arabia, UAE, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman + global
- **Pricing model**: Fixed-scope, fixed-price one-time fees for builds; optional $79+/mo care plans
- **Care plan starts**: $79/month
- **Code ownership**: client owns 100% — code, design files, accounts, domain at launch
- **Contact**: info@cloudtopia.net
- **Website**: https://cloudtopia.net
